request.title: TIG two-computer smoke: repair numeric addition
request.scope: Fix src/add.js so add(a, b) returns the numeric sum. Keep the exported function and tests unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: node --test test.mjs passes with no dependencies.
request.originalRequest: Repair the addition bug in this isolated smoke project to verify an actual TIG request and worker round trip on two computers.
request.context: This public scratch project has only a small JavaScript function and a built-in Node test. The initial test fails because the implementation subtracts.
request.completedWork: Created the isolated fixture and confirmed the baseline test fails: add(2, 3) returns -1 instead of 5.
constraints: Change only src/add.js; do not weaken the test.
No dependencies, network access or unrelated file changes are needed.
setupSteps: Use Node.js 24; no dependency installation is needed.
